summary: Identity, theming, and data provenance are strong on this third community; the calendar weekday-header legibility fix generalizes cleanly and event-RSVP numbers are internally consistent (real, non-hardcoded data). However the Home instance card exposed raw booleans ('Requires access approval: false') and a bare 'v' field label, the Giving tab renders an unexplained blank area with no empty-state messaging, and the Attendees list was clipped in the originally-captured screenshot (later confirmed to be an evidence-scroll gap, not a real regression, after scrolling further live). Two real shared-code gaps confirmed and fixed post-review: raw booleans and hyphenated identifiers (e.g. 'not-synced') were never humanized by CJM.11's original fix (closed as CJM.15), and the 'location' field was missing a labelTemplate (same pattern as 3 other communities, fixed directly).
findingsSummary: Full findings list (11 items) is preserved in the session transcript that produced this review; key items acted on: raw-package-fields-in-instance-card (booleans/bare-key 'v' -- partially addressed by CJM.15's boolean humanization; the bare 'v' key remains a JSON-level polish item, deferred), giving-tab-blank-not-empty-state (deferred, UX polish), content-clipped-by-bottom-nav / fab-occludes-content (re-verified live by scrolling to true max extent -- CJM.13's fix holds; this was an evidence-coverage gap, not a regression), no-rsvp-action-on-event (deferred, feature-completeness question not a rendering bug), remaining minor items (ISO date chips, month-cell truncation, '3 roles' ambiguity, bottom-nav tab clipping, internal jargon, update-confirmation-card) all deferred per the established accepted-findings precedent.
